visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair, wearing a blue and white striped shirt, stands in front of a white banner featuring a smile logo. He smiles broadly at the camera and gestures expressively with his hands while speaking. The setting appears to be a brightly lit indoor hallway. (2) The scene transitions to a large indoor event hall where the man walks towards the camera, pointing forward with a determined expression. In the background, many attendees are visible near event booths and a projection screen showing a presentation. (3) The man stands behind a display table covered with a red cloth, which is laden with various gift boxes and packaged food products. He waves energetically, surrounded by promotional materials and other event staff in a warm, indoor environment. (4) Close-up shots highlight the specific products being showcased, including boxes of cookies, pastries, and crackers. Small jewelry items shaped like fried eggs are displayed on elegant black stands, showing fine details of texture and color. (5) The man participates in a runway-style walk alongside a staff member dressed in a white baker's uniform and cap. They both hold gift boxes for the audience to see, while onlookers in the background capture the moment on their smartphones. (6) A female performer in a floral dress sings into a microphone on a stage featuring a blue backdrop with 'Moon Festival' graphics. Next to her, a man in a flat cap plays a black electronic keyboard, providing live accompaniment. (7) Returning to a closer view, the man holds a large gift box and a circular handheld sign with a smile logo. He speaks enthusiastically to the audience, presenting the interior of the box containing snacks and coffee products.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional vlog intended to showcase and encourage support for Taipei City's sheltered workshops. By featuring the Mid-Autumn Festival gift boxes and highlighting the stories and hard work of the staff members, the creator uses a high-energy, emotionally engaging approach to drive traffic to the 'Smile Mall' e-commerce site.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly promotes products from Taipei Sheltered Workshops and provides a specific call to action to visit their online store.
